Hi,

Thanks again for your help. I have filled in the RMA form. What happens
next?

Kind regards

Michael H.
Handed to the team · RMA form submitted Sep 25, chased Sep 26 and Oct 8, no return label or replaceme

Hi Michael,

Thanks for confirming, and sorry you had to chase this.

Here is what happens next. We send you a prepaid return label by email for the faulty S1. You print it, tape it to the box with the unit inside, and drop it off with the carrier, there is nothing to pay. Once it reaches the warehouse, processing takes up to 10 days, and your replacement goes out from there with tracking sent to this address.

Your RMA has sat too long without that label, so I have put it in front of the team. They are offline until 10am Eastern this morning and will pick it up then, and the label and next steps come back to you by email today.

Thanks for your patience with this one, Michael.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
That's great, thank you very much.
Handed to the team · Second chase, prepaid RMA label promised on Oct 8 still not sent

Hi Michael,

You are right to chase, and I am sorry. The label should have reached you by now.

There is nothing you need to do at your end to speed it up. I have put this back in front of the team as a priority. They come online at 10am Eastern today and will send the prepaid label to this address, along with confirmation of the replacement unit.

One thing that will save a round trip: reply with the full postal address and phone number the label should be issued to, so it can be raised straight away without anyone having to ask you first.

Once the label is with you, print it, tape it to the box with the S1 inside and drop it with the carrier. Processing takes up to 10 days from arrival at the warehouse, then your replacement ships with tracking.

Thanks for your patience, Michael.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

My address is

Phone number is +(number hidden)

Thanks again

Michael H.
Handed to the team · Customer supplied the collection address for the outstanding RMA label

Hi Michael,

Thank you, that is exactly what was needed. Your (address hidden) address and phone number are now on the RMA, so the label can be raised without anyone coming back to you.

The team is online from 10am Eastern today and this is at the top of their list. The prepaid label comes to this email address, along with confirmation of the replacement S1.

Nothing further for you to do until it lands. When it does, print it, tape it to the box with the faulty unit inside and drop it with the carrier.

Thanks again for your patience with this, Michael.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thanks again for the help but I still have not received the promised RMA
label to print. Can you please follow up on this again?

Kind regards

Michael H.
Handed to the team · RMA label promised three times and still not sent; customer has chased four time

Hi Michael,

No label has gone out, and I am not going to dress that up. You have chased this four times since you filled the form in on September 25, and twice now I have told you it was coming. That is not good enough.

I have escalated it again, this time named to Abel and Georges rather than the general queue. They are online at 10am Eastern today. Your address and phone are already on the RMA, so there is nothing left to gather, only the label to be issued.

I would also ask them to look at something for the trouble this has caused you, though I will not promise an amount I cannot action myself.

You will hear back on this today by email.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thank you for that and the fault is not on your side. I look forward to
receiving the email.

Kind regards

Michael H.

Hi Michael,

That is good of you to say, thank you.

It is with Abel and Georges now and they are on from 10am Eastern today. The label and the confirmation of your replacement S1 both come to this address.

If anything has not landed by the end of today, reply here and I will push it again rather than leave you waiting.

Kind regards,

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
